Communication

Team Communication & Strategy

Tell Stories That Matter

At Studio 1947, communication is more than creating content. It's about helping organisations, communities, and ideas connect with people in meaningful ways.

We're looking for someone curious about people, passionate about storytelling, and excited to work across design, research, technology, and social impact projects. Whether you're writing a campaign, developing social media content, interviewing stakeholders, or shaping communication strategies, your work will help transform complex ideas into stories that people understand, trust, and remember.

If you're the kind of person who notices good storytelling everywhere, saves interesting headlines, asks thoughtful questions, and enjoys turning ideas into narratives, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

  • Create engaging content for websites, social media, reports, newsletters, and campaigns.
  • Develop communication strategies for clients across different sectors.
  • Work closely with designers, researchers, and developers to build compelling narratives.
  • Assist in campaign planning and content calendars.
  • Conduct interviews and gather stories from communities, clients, and stakeholders.
  • Support branding, awareness campaigns, and outreach initiatives.
  • Monitor content performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Contribute fresh ideas during brainstorming sessions and creative workshops.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to simplify complex ideas into clear and engaging content.
  • Curiosity about culture, communities, technology, design, and social impact.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working independently and collaboratively.
  • Basic understanding of social media platforms and digital communication.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in content writing, journalism, public relations, or storytelling.
  • Familiarity with Canva, Notion, Google Workspace, or content management systems.
  • Photography, videography, or interview skills.
  • Experience working on campaigns or community-focused projects.

Why Join Studio 1947?

We're building a different kind of creative and technology studio. One that believes great ideas can come from the mountains of Darjeeling just as much as from major cities.

You'll work on diverse projects spanning branding, digital products, research, technology, social impact, and communication. Some days you'll help a startup shape its voice. Other days you'll support a research initiative, a community project, or a digital campaign reaching thousands of people.

You'll have space to experiment, learn, make mistakes, and grow.

Most importantly, you'll work with a team that values collaboration, creativity, curiosity, and meaningful impact.

Ready to Apply?

Send us your CV, portfolio, writing samples, or anything that helps us understand who you are and what you care about.

We're less interested in perfect resumes and more interested in thoughtful people who are excited to learn, create, and contribute.
